shots.intent: 用织纹与绣线微距证明做工与面料质感。

shots.intent: 一行色卷并列让买家完成颜色选择。
把套装内含拆成引线清单，消除买错件数风险。

style.backgroundSystem: alternate a sunlit bedroom with a light oak headboard, dappled wall shadows and small bedside props against clean infographic fields on white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F3EF and greige #C7BAB2; one blush wall #F1E4DE carries every lifestyle frame so the set reads as one campaign

style.lightingSystem: soft diffused daylight as the master system, front key with a low fill card, a gentle skimming side light that reveals weave, drape and hem topstitching, sweeping highlights along folded edges, low-contrast contact shadows, fabric always resting on a surface and never floating
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean home-textile bedding commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a pure white fabric field #FFFFFF, a warm blush wall #F1E4DE, a slate-blue accent #3E5C82 and deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; neutral temperature; one modern geometric sans-serif family with every in-image label wrapped in 「」 and supplied only as generic placeholders, headline 28-40pt and label 12-16pt, no serif or handwriting mixing and no dense body text; backgrounds alternate between a sunlit bedroom with a light oak headboard, dappled wall shadows and small bedside props and clean infographic fields on white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F3EF or greige #C7BAB2; soft diffused daylight as the master lighting system with a front key, a low fill card and a gentle skimming side light that reveals weave, drape and hem topstitching, sweeping highlights along folded edges and low-contrast contact shadows, fabric always resting on a surface and never floating; consistent thin-line pictograms inside solid slate-blue circular chips plus rounded pill label chips with empty ruled label lines instead of values; stable slight 3/4 eye-level hero angle for the dressed bed and identical scale and spacing across every row; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented dimensions, piece counts, certifications or test data, no brand wordmark, woven label, barcode or QR code.
noDrift: no invented dimensions, piece counts, certifications or test data
no brand wordmark, woven label, barcode or QR code
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 eye-level hero angle for the dressed bed, identical roll and fold scale across variant rows, consistent drape direction, product always grounded with a contact shadow, people cropped or turned away so no face is identifiable
style.surfaceSystem: dressed mattress on a light wood bed base over a warm walnut floor; folded stacks and detail crops on a smooth ivory board; fabric laid, folded or held taut by hands, never suspended without support
